title: Separated finite-type morphisms are stable under base change
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes that is separated and of finite type (locally of finite type and quasi-compact) [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let $g:S'\to S$ be any morphism of schemes. Then the base change $f':X\times_SS'\to S'$ is separated and of finite type. In particular, for a field extension $k/k_0$ and a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $Y_0$, the scheme $Y_0\times_{k_0}k$ is a separated finite-type $k$-scheme.
